On Wed, Jul 25, 2028 at 12:08 +0100 jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Marissa / Ben — can you run an availability sweep and propose the minimal node mix...

Checked fleet inventory and ran a quick simulation against current commitments. Summary:
- EU pool has capacity but it's fragmented across mixed-instance types. Achievable: 120 A100-eq/day can be satisfied with either:
  * Option A (single-variant): 6 x H100-80GB nodes using burst quota (preferred for latency-sensitive workloads).
  * Option B (mixed): 8 x A100-80GB + 4 x L40s in a heterogeneous config (cost-optimized, slightly higher tail latency).
- Contention windows: weeks of heavy model training on Aug 8–12 may reduce burst headroom. If Eclipse needs strict guaranteed throughput during that week we should mark a soft-reserve for Aug 5–15.
- Reservation mechanics: Ops can set a 21-day provisional hold with an auto-release flag. Hold requires authorization from Capacity Manager (Laura Bennett) and a billing agreement indicating either prepaid runway or monthly commit billing.

Attachments: fleet-plan-v2.xlsx (node mix + hour-by-hour runway simulation).

Recommendation: propose to the customer a 21-day provisional hold (Aug 5–26) for the initial ramp, with an option to convert to a committed reserved slice if they sign a 90-day commitment before Aug 15. That buys us a buffer for the Aug 8–12 contention window and meets their ask to include a hold in procurement materials.

Marissa Cole
Head, Capacity Ops | Redwood Inference

Maya — quick note to confirm next steps and the hold we can issue for your package.

- Hold window: 2028-08-05 to 2028-08-26 (auto-release on 2028-08-27 unless converted).
- Node mapping: recommended Option A (6x H100-80GB nodes) for best latency; Option B (mixed A100/L40) available if budget constrained. See attached fleet-plan-v2.xlsx for hour-by-hour assumptions.

- Cancellation: customer may cancel hold with 72-hour notice prior to the start date; after activation, standard cancellation terms apply as in the hold statement.

Laura has authorized retention in the EU capacity pool pending your confirmation. If this looks good we can produce a one-page hold statement for procurement to attach to your legal packet by tomorrow EOD.
